title: KPMG and OpenAI form Strategic Alliance to Advance AI-Native Enterprise Workflows
title_zh: KPMG与OpenAI达成战略联盟，共同推进AI原生企业工作流程
full_text:
KPMG and OpenAI form Strategic Alliance to Advance AI-Native Enterprise Workflows, with KPMG Named an Elite Partner
KPMG has been named an OpenAI Elite Partner, the highest tier within the OpenAI Partner Network.
This partnership advances KPMG’s approach to enable AI-native experiences that transform how organizations interact with enterprise data, workflows and systems.
KPMG will modernize its public sector portfolio of SaaS tools with OpenAI technology to help clients improve outcomes of government programs and services and enhance the user experience.
KPMG will help organizations bolster AI-powered cyber defense and threat intelligence as part of KPMG’s role as a partner for OpenAI Daybreak Cyber Partner Program.
July 21, 2026
NEW YORK, NY — July 21, 2026 — KPMG LLP, the U.S. audit, tax and advisory firm, today announced a strategic alliance with OpenAI to help organizations reimagine how employees and customers, across the public and private sectors, interact with enterprise software in the AI era.
The alliance is an important milestone in KPMG’s effort to help clients move beyond application-centric experiences toward a new enterprise operating model where AI becomes the system of engagement, and enterprise applications continue to serve as the systems of record. Through the alliance, and as an OpenAI Elite Partner, KPMG and OpenAI will help organizations reimagine how work gets done by bringing AI directly into the flow of enterprise processes, enabling faster decisions, more intelligent automation and simpler user experiences.
KPMG is also partnering with OpenAI to design and deploy an AI-native Supply Chain & Fulfillment Orchestration platform for their own organization that unifies supply chain operations, fulfillment and finance through intelligent workflows and agents.
"SaaS is evolving; it's becoming agentic. We’re designing AI-enabled systems that will act as the front door for customers and employees to engage. This approach requires collaboration across the technology ecosystem, and OpenAI is a critical partner to KPMG as we help clients move from software-led transformation to intelligent systems that work across the enterprise technology stack,” said Chad Seiler, U.S. Industry Leader for Technology, Media and Telecommunications, KPMG LLP.
Reinventing Enterprise Software Through AI-First Experiences
KPMG is working within OpenAI’s own environment as a client-zero deployment to help design a new model for the AI-first enterprise. This demonstrates how organizations can move beyond traditional application-centric experiences toward a more intuitive and headless model of enterprise engagement, where AI becomes the system of engagement while enterprise applications continue to serve as the system of record. KPMG will accelerate delivery through a forward deployed engineer (FDE) model, embedding senior engineers directly alongside OpenAI teams to rapidly translate business needs into production-ready solutions. KPMG FDEs will go through OpenAI FDE certification to rapidly translate business needs into production-ready solutions.
"Organizations are looking beyond pilots and proofs of concept to fundamentally reshape how work gets done," said Colleen Kapase, Vice President of Strategic Global Partnerships and Ecosystems at OpenAI . "As an OpenAI Elite Partner, KPMG brings deep transformation, industry and implementation experience that can help organizations deploy OpenAI's technology in new and impactful ways. Together, we’re applying OpenAI’s models directly within enterprise systems and public-sector platforms so organizations can use AI where work actually happens."
KPMG’s approach represents a significant step toward a new generation of headless SaaS experiences that simplify how people access information, make decisions and complete work across enterprise systems.
Accelerating State and Local Government Modernization
The alliance will also advance KPMG’s work with state and local governments in the U.S. through the modernization of KRIS Connected, KPMG’s suite of SaaS solutions designed to support public-sector agencies. KPMG and OpenAI will help government agencies move from siloed legacy systems to connected case management, service delivery and decision support.
The next generation of KRIS Connected will help empower government agencies to elevate critical functions while improving experiences for citizens, caseworkers, and program administrators. These AI-powered solutions can help agencies modernize incrementally, reduce risk, and accelerate time to value.
Strengthening Cyber Defense Through Trusted AI
Building on KPMG’s participation in the OpenAI Daybreak Cyber Partner Program , the alliance also brings together OpenAI’s cyber capabilities and KPMG’s cyber and Trusted AI expertise to help organizations strengthen threat detection and security operations.
As a partner for the OpenAI Daybreak Cyber Partner Program, KPMG will help integrate OpenAI models and cyber capabilities into next-generation, AI-powered cybersecurity solutions. This will help accelerate the shift from traditional services to intelligent, scalable platforms and enhance KPMG’s ability to deliver faster, more automated and insight-driven security outcomes for clients, helping them strengthen resilience and respond to an increasingly complex threat landscape.
Some or all of the services described herein may not be permissible for KPMG audit clients and their affiliates or related entities.
About KPMG LLP:
KPMG LLP is the US member firm of the KPMG global organization of independent member firms providing Audit, Tax and Advisory services. The KPMG global organization operates in 138 countries and territories and has more than 276,000 people working in member firms around the world. Each KPMG firm is a legally distinct and separate entity and describes itself as such. KPMG International Limited is a private English company limited by guarantee. KPMG International Limited and its related entities do not provide services to clients.
KPMG is widely recognized for being a great place to work and build a career. Our people share a sense of purpose in the work we do, and a strong commitment to increasing access to education and opportunity, advancing mental health, and supporting community vitality. Learn more at www.kpmg.com/us .
Media Contact
For media inquiries, contact Alison Wentley ( awentley@kpmg.com ).
